## Instructions

1. In this assignment you will discuss the Blizzard salary dataset. Please download it from Canvas before class starts.
2. The discussion will revolve around [Part E of HW4](../hw/hw4.qmd#part-e-reflection).
3. You are not expected to answer these questions in complete detail, or to clean the data in 40 minutes. The discussion is meant to help you come up with a plan to carefully analyze this dataset.
4. **Actively participate in the discussion**. Anyone can contribute by using `pandas` to inspect the dataset, or thinking carefully about the context in which the data were collected (look for the associated Bloomberg article and/or the screenshot attached to the ZIP file).
5. This is an open-ended assignment. The value of your report is in documenting your thought process.

### Deliverables

- Create a directory named `lab4` as with other assignments.
- Include a report named `reflection.qmd`.
    + Give a few examples of how you inspected the data, particularly strategies that might be helpful for HW4.
    + Provide answers to as many of the questions in [Part E](../hw/hw4.qmd#part-e-reflection).
    + Include a few concrete ideas for addressing various issues in the dataset (see the rest of HW4).

## Suggestions

- Use `ipython` instead of the default `python` REPL.
  + This lets you save the commands from your session with the [magic command](https://ipython.readthedocs.io/en/stable/interactive/magics.html#magic-save) `%save myfilename.py`.
- Thinking about one column/variable at a time is the "easy thing" that our minds are naturally drawn to. Look more broadly and reflect on how these variables might interact or correlate with one another.
- Don't forget to **tag** your submission; e.g. `git tag lab4`.
- Don't forget to **push your tags** with `git push --tags`.
